# Rule 5- Respect Other Communities [bold]Don't shit talk[/bold]. We all come from a multitude of other communities and experiences, none of which should be innately invalidated.
Both SpL and its attached Discord server are spaces to facilitate a high roleplay experience, not ones to complain about other forks in. Treat other communities with the respect you would wish them to treat us with, and their players the way you would wish them to treat you.
## Reasonable vs. Unreasonable Bringing up other forks is not banned, nor is speaking negatively or positively of them. The line is drawn at mockery and exclusionism. The whitelist is not an echo chamber– don't make fun of players or staff from other forks on the basis of them being from those other forks, and don't use the existence of the whitelist as a free pass for gossip and slander.
You may discuss the conduct of players from other servers and the content of the servers themselves without limitation as long as you remain respectful. Any conversation, even about those not a part of SpL, should remain compliant with [textlink="Rule 1" link="RuleSpL1"].
